test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held on: 2 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: **Select the sentence which does NOT have a spelling error.**

options.text: There is a statutory warning on every packet of cigaretes.
There is a statuary warning on every packet of cigarettes.
There is a statutory warning on every packet of cigarettes.
There is a statutory warning on every packet of cigerettes.

solution:
The correct answer is "**There is a statutory warning on every packet of cigarettes.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The sentence that does NOT have a spelling error is "There is a statutory warning on every packet of **cigarettes**"
 
• All other options contain **spelling errors**. 
 
• **Option 1** has a spelling error in "**cigaretes**", **option 2** has a spelling error in "**statuary**", and **option 4** has a spelling error in "**cigerettes**".

Thus, ***option 3*** is the correct answer.
